text: ___ MD runs multiple replicas of a system at different temperatures and periodically attempts to swap configurations between them using a Metropolis criterion, helping the simulation escape local energy minima.
explanation: Replica Exchange MD (REMD) uses high-temperature replicas to cross energy barriers and periodic Metropolis-criterion swaps to let low-temperature replicas sample diverse conformational states, addressing the tendency of standard MD to become trapped in local minima beyond about 1 microsecond.
